rules: Preview, product rollout, API availability, GA, availability expansion, and deprecation remain separate chronology events when objectively distinct.
Vendor/project benchmark and performance claims remain attributed rather than independently reproduced.
Open weights, license permissiveness, source availability, hosted API access, data transparency, and edge deployability are separate properties.
Agent research prototypes, computer-use beta, protocol releases, and broadly available products remain separate availability identities.
DeepSeek-R1 public release belongs to 2025-H1 and must not be back-projected into DeepSeek-V3's December 2024 event.
Reader-facing drafting begins only after Human Gate 1 Architecture approval.
